description: Department of Forest Conservation - Declare the Sinharaja Forest as Reserved Forest
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters - specifically the declaration of Sinharaja Forest as a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. It involves the exercise of statutory powers, references to specific legislation and amendments, and the repeal of previous gazette notifications. The content focuses on establishing a legal framework for forest conservation rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
